newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn lowers yield on 5-year Bobl bonds.
newsitem.headline: Bonn lowers yield on 5-year Bobl bonds.

text.p: The German government on Tuesday lowered the yield on its Series 121 five-year Bundesobligationen bonds, or Bobls, by raising the issue price to 101.30 from 101.10, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said.
The move, effective from 1100 GMT on Tuesday, lowered the yield on the bonds to 4.45 percent from 4.50 percent.
It was the second time in two days that the government lowered the yield on the bonds, which are issued on tap to non-bank investors like private individuals and charities.
